results_m4_real_faults.milestone: Milestone M4 v3 Enhanced Safety Evaluation (Id-Verified vs Opaque Tool Regimes)
results_m4_real_faults.benchmark_nature: Controlled Mechanism Evaluation: Demonstrates recovery mechanism under an injected 40/30/15/15 fault mix. Transient probe crashes recover on retry by construction, and id-based lookup avoids the race by construction. Operational field deferral rates depend on real network distributions and are measured via Soro Shadow Mode.
results_m4_real_faults.breakthrough_finding: By embedding action_id into write payloads and querying by correlation id (rather than generic state), Soro cuts confirmation deferral from 30.0% down to 5.4% while maintaining 0.0% duplicate mutations. The 30.0% deferral rate remains strictly necessary only in opaque tools where no correlation ID can be embedded.

results_m2_m3_conformal_pasc.milestone: Milestone M2 & M3 Conformal v2 (Honest Mondrian LAC & Ablated Cascade)
results_m2_m3_conformal_pasc.protocol_note: T2 PASC cascade claim officially dropped; T2 keyword penalty was monotonic, making max(nc1, nc2) degenerate.

mondrian_lac_conformal.temperature_fit_regime: Fit on disjoint 126-query calibration split per fold (grid-search NLL)
mondrian_lac_conformal.dataset_limitation_finding: On this easy public benchmark (Gemini embeddings), fixed top-1 already achieves 95.6% coverage at set size 1.00. Conformal prediction yields no candidate reduction here. The domain where conformal sets buy efficiency is when top-1 is weak (MiniLM at 74.7% / v2 at 32.5%), where LAC delivers ~92.5% coverage at mean size 2.07 vs size 5.0 for fixed-k.

cascade_ablation.finding: Degenerate. Monotonic penalty causes max(nc1, nc2) = nc2 on every query.
cascade_ablation.recommendation: Cascade dropped. Single-stage Mondrian LAC is the mathematically rigorous protocol.

matched_coverage_comparison.statistical_significance_note: Wilson 95% confidence intervals overlap between Conformal LAC [88.57%, 95.14%], fixed k=3 [87.64%, 94.51%], and fixed k=4 [89.98%, 96.07%]. The advantage of conformal prediction here is adaptive candidate set sizing (mean 2.07 tools) with distribution-free finite-sample coverage guarantees, rather than a fixed arbitrary depth.
